42621-poems-containing-the-restropect-od.title: Poems
42621-poems-containing-the-restropect-od.creator: Robert Lovell,
42621-poems-containing-the-restropect-od.description: A book by Robert Lovell,. As on I journey through the vale of years,  Cheer'd by fond hopes, and chill'd by doubtful fears;  Allow me, Memory, in thy treasur'd store,  To view those days that will return no more:  Oh! let thy vivid pencil call to view  Each distant scene, each long-past hour anew,  Ere yet my bosom knew the touch of grief,  Ere yet my bosom lov'd the lyre's relief.

arxiv-2007-03030.title: Time-energy uncertainty does not create particles
arxiv-2007-03030.creator: B W Roberts 1 and J Butterfield 2
arxiv-2007-03030.description: Abstract In this contribution in honour of Paul Busch, we criticise the claims of many expositions that the time-energy uncertainty principle allows both a violation of energy conservation, and particle creation, provided that this happens for a sufficiently short time.

arxiv-2102-13268.title: DRIBO: Robust Deep Reinforcement Learning via Multi-View Information Bottleneck
arxiv-2102-13268.creator: Jiameng Fan, Wenchao Li
arxiv-2102-13268.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents are often sensitive to visual changes that were unseen in their training environments. To address this problem, we leverage the sequential nature of RL to learn robust representations that encode only task-relevant information from observations based on the unsupervised multi-view setting.

arxiv-2203-12399.title: PRTT: Precomputed Radiance Transfer Textures CCS: Computing methodologies Rasterization CCS: Computing methodologies Ray tracing CCS: Computing methodologies Visibility
arxiv-2203-12399.creator: Sirikonda Dhawal, Aakash KT, P.J. Narayanan
arxiv-2203-12399.description: Abstract . Precomputed Radiance Transfer (PRT) can achieve high quality renders of glossy materials at real-time framerates. PRT involves precomputing a k k -dimensional transfer vector of Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficients at specific points for a scene. Most prior art precomputes transfer at vertices of the mesh and interpolates color for interior points.

arxiv-2304-03166.title: Equivariant Vector Bundles on the Drinfeld Upper Half Space over a Local Field of Positive Characteristic
arxiv-2304-03166.creator: Georg Linden
arxiv-2304-03166.description: Abstract . We describe the locally analytic GL d ​ ( K ) {\mathrm{GL}}_{d}(K) -representations which arise as the global sections of homogeneous vector bundles on the projective space restricted to the Drinfeld upper half space over a non-archimedean local field K K .

arxiv-2311-07102.title: Fovea Transformer: Efficient Long-Context Modeling with Structured Fine-to-Coarse Attention
arxiv-2311-07102.creator: Ziwei He, Jian Yuan, Le Zhou, Jingwen Leng, Bo Jiang
arxiv-2311-07102.description: Abstract The quadratic complexity of self-attention in Transformers has hindered the processing of long text. To alleviate this problem, previous works have proposed to sparsify the attention matrix, taking advantage of the observation that crucial information about a token can be derived from its neighbors. These methods typically combine one or another form of local attention and global attention.

arxiv-2405-05131.title: DenserRadar: A 4D millimeter-wave radar point cloud detector based on dense LiDAR point clouds
arxiv-2405-05131.creator: Zeyu Han, Junkai Jiang, Xiaokang Ding, Qingwen Meng, Shaobing Xu, Lei He, Jianqiang Wang
arxiv-2405-05131.description: Abstract The 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, with its robustness in extreme environments, extensive detection range, and capabilities for measuring velocity and elevation, has demonstrated significant potential for enhancing the perception abilities of autonomous driving systems in corner-case scenarios. Nevertheless, the inherent sparsity and noise of 4D mmWave radar point clouds restrict its further development and practical application.

arxiv-2407-18364.title: Corrections of Electron-Phonon coupling for Second-Order Structural Phase Transitions
arxiv-2407-18364.description: Abstract Structural phase transitions are accompanied by a movement of one nucleus (or a few) in the crystallographic unit cell. If the nucleus movement is continuous, a second order phase transition without latent heat results, whereas an abrupt nucleus displacement indicates a first order phase transition with accompanying latent heat.

arxiv-2410-13192.title: Evaluating Self-Generated Documents for Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-13192.creator: Jiatao Li, Xinyu Hu, Xunjian Yin, Xiaojun Wan
arxiv-2410-13192.description: Abstract The integration of documents generated by LLMs themselves (Self-Docs) alongside retrieved documents has emerged as a promising strategy for retrieval-augmented generation systems. However, previous research primarily focuses on optimizing the use of Self-Docs, with their inherent properties remaining underexplored.

arxiv-2501-14895.title: Data assimilation in 2D nonlinear coupled sound and heat flow, using a stabilized explicit finite difference scheme marched backward in time.
arxiv-2501-14895.creator: Alfred S. Carasso
arxiv-2501-14895.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alfred S. Carasso. This paper considers the ill-posed data assimilation problem associated with hyperbolic/parabolic systems describing 2D coupled sound and heat flow. Given hypothetical data at time T > 0 T>0 , that may not correspond to an actual solution of the dissipative system at time T T , initial data at time t = 0 t=0 are sought that can evolve, through the dissipative system, into a useful approximation to the desired data at time T T .

britannica-1911-jerez-de-la-frontera.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jerez-de-la-frontera.description: Article 'Jeréz de la Frontera' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. southern Spain, in the province of Cadiz, near the right bank of the river Guadalete, and on the Seville-Cadiz railway, about 7 m. from the Atlantic coast. Jeréz is built in the midst of an undulating plain of great fertility. Its whitewashed houses, clean, broad streets, and squares planted with trees extend far beyond the limits formerly enclosed by the Moorish walls, almost entirely demolished.

pmc-10508909.title: The impact of comorbidities on tuberculosis treatment outcomes in Poland: a national cohort study
pmc-10508909.creator: Adam Nowiński, Stefan Wesołowski, Maria Korzeniewska-Koseła
pmc-10508909.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) is a complex disease associated with other medical conditions, that may affect disease severity. This study aimed to investigate the impact of comorbidities on treatment outcomes and mortality rates in patients with TB in Poland.MethodsWe analyzed a national cohort of 19,217 adult TB patients diagnosed between 2011 and 2016 in Poland.

pmc-11395874.title: Reclaiming the concept of professionalism in the digital context: a principle-based concept analysis
pmc-11395874.creator: Shaista Salman Guraya, Salman Yousuf Guraya, Fiza Rashid-Doubell, Salim Fredericks, Denis W. Harkin, Mohd Zarawi bin Mat Nor, Muhamad Saiful Bahri Yusoff
pmc-11395874.description: BackgroundThere has been an alarming surge in the usage of social networking sites (SNSs) by healthcare professionals (HCPs) without adherence to the principles of professionalism. The widespread use of SNSs in medical practices has been coupled with reports of breaches of professional behaviors.

pmc-11487551.title: Dietary therapies interlinking with gut microbes toward human health: Past, present, and future
pmc-11487551.creator: Jiali Chen, Jiaqiang Luo, Sjaak Pouwels, Beijinni Li, Bian Wu, Tamer N Abdelbaki, Jayashree Arcot, Wah Yang
pmc-11487551.description: Overview of personalized dietary therapies. This flow chart exhibits the future prospect for integrating human microbiome and bio‐medical research to revolutionize the precise personalized dietary therapies. With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), incorporating database may achieve personalized dietary therapies with high precision.

pmc-12542556.title: Role of health workers and representative health worker organisations in LMIC pharmaceutical policy: a scoping review protocol
pmc-12542556.creator: Daniel Eisenkraft Klein, Muhammad Naveed Noor, Lindsey Eiwanger, Janice Linton, Ursula Ellis, Veena Sriram
pmc-12542556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AbstractIntroductionHealth workers (HWs) and their representative health worker organisations (RHWOs) contribute to the design of pharmaceutical policy in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), but their roles remain underappreciated. HWs and RHWOs can influence drug development, distribution, financing and access; however, which specific aspects HWs and RHWOs contribute to, and how they create change, remains insufficiently mapped within the global health literature.

pmc-12562374.title: Orofacial Pain and Temporomandibular Disorders Education at Umm Al-Qura University: Perceptions and Curriculum Improvement Recommendations
pmc-12562374.creator: Mohammad Hasan Al-Harthy, Hans S Malmstrom
pmc-12562374.description: Objectives: To evaluate dental students’ and recent graduates’ perceptions of the integration, effectiveness, quality, and clinical relevance of orofacial pain (OFP) and temporomandibular disorders (TMDs) education in the Oral Medicine (OM) course at Umm Al-Qura University’s Faculty of Dental Medicine (UQUDENT), and to identify educational gaps and opportunities for curriculum improvement.

pmc-12670659.title: Telemedicine Gatekeeping Over 15,000 Patients from Specialist Consultation Waiting Lists: A Cost-Minimization Study
pmc-12670659.creator: Juliana Nunes Pfeil, Rudi Roman, Dimitris Rucks Varvaki Rados, Roberto Nunes Umpierre, Matheus Grassi de Oliveira, Ana Paula Beck da Silva Etges, Rodolfo Souza da Silva, Natan Katz, Rita Mattiello, Erno Harzheim
pmc-12670659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objective:This study assesses the cost-minimization of the RegulaSUS telemedicine program, reducing the necessity for face-to-face specialist consultations.Methods:A cost analysis study, utilizing a retrospective cohort design, was conducted from January 2017 to December 2019. The gatekeeping process for waiting lists for specialized consultations was performed by two groups: the RegulaSUS program through telemedicine intervention and those regulated by the usual procedures of the Ambulatory Regulation Center of the State of Rio Grande do Sul (the contemporaneous controls group).

pmc-12916658.title: Case Report: Cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator gene heterozygous variation presenting with abdominal pain and hepatopancreatic lesions in a child
pmc-12916658.creator: Xiu Lu, Lidong Ning, Hong Zhen, Ming Liang, Yulan Han, Hongyan Wei, Lingdong Zeng, Lihong Wei, Liqin Tan
pmc-12916658.description: BackgroundCystic fibrosis (CF) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene, leading to multi-system involvement.Case reportA 4-year-old girl presented with a 2-day history of abdominal pain. Clinical manifestations included recurrent epigastric pain and vomiting.

pmc-13215660.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Skin Parameter Assessment in Indian Adults: Establishing Population-Specific Reference Data for Clinical Dermatology
pmc-13215660.creator: Saurabh Arora, Neha Arora, Manoj Karwa, Surya T Reddy
pmc-13215660.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI)-based skin analysis enables objective, large-scale assessment of dermatologic features; however, population-specific normative reference ranges for Indian skin remain limited. This exploratory study aimed to establish percentile-based reference distributions for facial skin parameters in Indian adults, predominantly comprising Fitzpatrick skin types III-V, who demonstrate distinct pigmentary and aging patterns that are underrepresented in the existing literature.

pmc-13296203.title: Enhancing Whole Slide Image Classification in Renal Cell Carcinoma via Swin Transformer-Based Multiple Instance Learning
pmc-13296203.creator: Bohan Zhang, Zhen Gao
pmc-13296203.description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) comprises histologic subtypes with distinct prognosis and treatment implications. This single-cohort study evaluated slide-level weakly supervised subtype classification for clear cell RCC (ccRCC), papillary RCC (pRCC), and chromophobe RCC (chRCC) using 928 diagnostic H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) from 928 patients in TCGA-RCC.

pmc-13347112.title: Multilocus re-evaluation of species boundaries in the Central European Psilopteryx psorosa species group (Trichoptera, Limnephilidae) with shallow morphological differentiation
pmc-13347112.creator: Michaela Šamulková, Tomáš Navara, Pavel Chvojka, Zuzana Čiamporová-Zaťovičová, Patrik Macko
pmc-13347112.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The caddisfly genus Psilopteryx Stein, 1874 (Limnephilidae) represents a taxonomically challenging group in which species boundaries have traditionally been defined solely by adult morphology, as larval stages lack reliable diagnostic characters. This difficulty is particularly evident within the Psilopteryx psorosa species group in Central Europe, where species delimitation has relied primarily on subtle and often variable differences in male genital morphology, while reliable diagnostic characters for larvae and females remain unavailable.

pmc-13378235.title: A Novel HILIC‐UPLC‐DAD‐MS/MS Method for the Analysis of Mycosporine‐Like Amino Acids and Their Quantification in Diverse Algae
pmc-13378235.creator: Armin Oberosler, Anastasiia Fedorova, Ignacio Zegri, Fabian Hammerle, Michael Zwerger, Thomas Werner, Markus Ganzera
pmc-13378235.description: Mycosporine‐like amino acids (MAAs) are photoprotective compounds primarily produced by marine organisms, especially red algae. Chemically, MAAs and their precursors are low‐molecular‐weight natural products that absorb ultraviolet radiation in the range of 270–360 nm without generating free radicals. Owing to these properties, MAAs have attracted considerable interest for potential pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications as natural sunscreen agents.

uslaw-usc-t10-s18505.title: 10 U.S.C. § 18505 — Reserves traveling for inactive-duty training: space-required travel on military aircraft
uslaw-usc-t10-s18505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s18505.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part V (Service, Supply, And Procurement); Chapter 1805 (Miscellaneous Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) A member of a reserve component traveling for inactive-duty training (including a place other than the place of the member’s unit training assembly if the member is performing inactive-duty training in another location) may travel in a space-required status.
